positions.name: MeridianGatePolicyFrame
positions.frame: what are the terms of the Meridian deployment gate — its requirement, scope, and ownership?
positions.why: src-1 and src-3 both state the signed-manifest requirement (prose and structured-field form), src-4 fixes where it applies, and src-5 fixes who holds it — read together these four cohere as facets of one gate definition rather than four separate claims. src-2, which supplies the rationale/incident behind the gate rather than the gate's terms, is left out of this read.
